user_visible_outcome: The production Admin Content library loads publication state normally and allows the shared administrator to open Chapter editors.
non_negotiable_quality: Preserve all PR-004B revision, publication, privacy, Letter-blocking, shared-admin and immutable-history behavior.
realistic_harms_prevented: Do not mutate database schema/data, Auth, Storage, migrations or unrelated product behavior while fixing the failed production query.
simplest_acceptable_approach: Disambiguate the existing content_revisions to content_revision_media PostgREST embed with the intended revision_id foreign-key relationship.
non_goals: No UI redesign, dependency update, migration, revision-model change, admin-account change or release-scope expansion.
complexity_budget: One production source file; no dependency; INR 0/month. Add no abstraction unless verification proves it necessary.
verification: Confirm bounded diff, build/type/test evidence, deploy only the verified patch, then verify production /admin/content no longer logs PGRST201 and the administrator can open a Chapter editor without mutation.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The revision embed explicitly selects content_revision_media_revision_id_fkey, eliminating PGRST201 ambiguity while retaining all revision media rows.
No database, migration, dependency, Auth, Storage, publication-rule or unrelated source change is introduced.
The verified patch builds successfully and production /admin/content loads without the publication-state error or ContentLibraryPage revision-query PGRST201 log.
The shared administrator can open an existing non-Home Chapter editor read-only and Letter publication remains unavailable; sign-out/Back privacy remains previously passed.
